name: CEL_PROGRAMS_B
description: MLS base table to hold details of celebrate programs.

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a celebrate program

columns.name: TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates type of program

columns.name: SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates subtype of program

columns.name: AWARD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates type of award

columns.name: VISIBILITY_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates visibility of the awards and recognitions through the program

columns.name: TIME_UNIT_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates time unit of program

columns.name: TIME_UNIT_COUNT
columns.description: Time unit count for recurring programs

columns.name: TRIGGER_TIME_UNIT_COUNT
columns.description: Trigger in advance time count

columns.name: POINTS_RANGE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates range of points

columns.name: POINTS_MINIMUM
columns.description: Minimum value allowed for points

columns.name: POINTS_MAXIMUM
columns.description: Maximum value allowed for points

columns.name: POINTS_INCREMENT
columns.description: Increment allowed for points

columns.name: OWNERS_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if owners are enabled for the program

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Program start date

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Program end date

columns.name: USE_POINTS_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that identifies if program uses points

columns.name: SENDER_LIMIT_MAXIMUM
columns.description: Maximum number of recognitions/awards per sender

columns.name: RECEIVER_LIST_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the list of receivers

columns.name: RECOGNITION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which recognition/award is to be sent

columns.name: NOMINATION_END_DATE
columns.description: End date for nominations

columns.name: SELECTION_END_DATE
columns.description: End date for selection of winners

columns.name: WINNERS_TOTAL
columns.description: Total number of winners

columns.name: WINNERS_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if winner selection is enabled for the program

columns.name: ALLOW_VISIBILITY_CHANGE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if visibility options can be modified for a program by users

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a questionnaire

columns.name: QSTNR_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the questionnaire
